channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Hidden genetic diversity helped inbred brown tree snakes conquer Guam
item.description: A notorious snake invasion that devastated Guam's native birds may have succeeded because the reptiles carried hidden genetic advantages.

item.title: The best way to save giant sequoias may be more fire
item.description: Giant sequoias are built to withstand ordinary fires, but recent extreme wildfires killed thousands of trees that had survived for centuries.

item.title: Inside the Backrooms: The internet's creepiest place is becoming a tourist attraction
item.description: The Backrooms started as a single eerie image of empty yellow rooms, but internet users turned it into a vast fictional world that feels disturbing.

item.title: Scientists trace the shocking origin of human eyes to an ancient cyclops
item.description: Researchers say a tiny one-eyed ancestor that lived nearly 600 million years ago may have shaped the evolution of every vertebrate eye, including ours.
